title: Welcome to my new Portfolio!
description: Welcome to my updated personal website built with React, Vite, and Decap CMS.
body:
Hi everyone!

I have revamped my website to make it cleaner, faster, and more concise. I migrated from Gatsby to **Vite + React + TypeScript** and set up **Decap CMS** so I can easily add new blog posts about my learnings and portfolio projects.

### What I do
I am Usman, a **Data Engineer** passionate about building robust data pipelines, processing large datasets, and optimizing data infrastructure.

Stay tuned for more posts about data engineering, cloud platforms, Python, SQL, and database technologies!
